messages:
Evan (AE): Hey team — kicking off Orion Labs POC. Main ask: validate retrieval-augmented Q&A + structured extraction from product docs. Proposed timeline: 3 weeks (week 1 ingest + config, week 2 eval/prompts, week 3 tweaks + handoff). Can we align success criteria and owners?
Priya (Solutions): High level ok. Quick Qs: what are the primary KPIs? accuracy on extraction? latency SLO? cost target? Also who will own prompt evals from customer's side?
Evan (AE): Good call. Draft success criteria: 1) extraction accuracy >= 88% on labeled set (50 samples), 2) retrieval recall @k=5 >= 90% for dev queries, 3) median generation latency < 600ms and P95 < 1.8s on our hosted plan, 4) baseline cost estimate under $X/day (TBD after rough traffic). Customer to provide 20 canonical prompts + 50 labeled extraction examples.
Marta (Orion): We can provide the 50 labeled examples and a subset of production queries. On latency: we need to see end-to-end numbers from our app (client side + network). Also security questionnaire in progress, expected back by EOD Friday.
Diego (Eng): For the latency targets, which model family do you want us to test? We can run both an Llama-3 quantized variant and a slightly bigger gpt-like open model. Need to know max sequence length and expected concurrent users (rough qps).
Marta (Orion): Sequence length typical ~800 tokens. Concurrent: starts small, ~10 rps for POC burst, but we'd like to see linear scaling to 100 rps.
Priya (Solutions): Notes for POC plan: - data ingest: S3 upload or share via signed bucket - index: embeddings (open model) + hybrid brute-force for recall - eval harness: we'll run a small eval that runs the 20 prompts and the 50 labeled extraction checks and produce diff reports.
Evan (AE): Action items: Evan to schedule 30m kickoff w/Orion + infra/solutions (today 3pm PT?), Marta to confirm dataset upload method, Diego to provision test endpoint and quantify cost inputs, Priya to create eval template and success dashboard.
Marta (Orion): 3pm PT works. For upload prefer S3 presigned URLs. Security questionnaire: concerned about audit logs and KMS—we use enterprise HSM for key material.
security-bot: Hi @Marta (Orion) — here's the enterprise security checklist link: https://redwood.example/security/questionnaire. We support KMS/HSM integration and can provide audit export to your SIEM. Please note SLA add-on required for guaranteed retention windows.
Diego (Eng): For KMS/HSM we need to confirm key proxied vs customer-managed. If they require customer-managed keys in HSM, that pushes this to Private deployment scope (adds ~2 week setup). Either way we can run the POC on Hosted with dummy keys for testing.
Evan (AE): Good flag on private vs hosted. Marta, if HSM enforcement is mandatory for POC, note that timeline moves. If not, we run a hosted POC and demonstrate data controls.
Marta (Orion): For the POC we can accept hosted with dummy key material as long as we have contract language for KMS roadmap. We'll confirm in the questionnaire.
Priya (Solutions): Prompt examples (for eval): ```
1) "Given the product doc, extract warranty_period and format as ISO date"
2) "Summarize the steps to onboard a new device in 3 bullets"
``` We'll include a few adversarial prompts to check hallucination.
Evan (AE): Pricing question from procurement: will trial credits cover the test traffic costs + a small Dedicated burst if we need it? I can escalate if Diego can provide an estimate.
Diego (Eng): I can run a quick cost-projection: need expected tokens/day (approx). For POC with 20 prompts x 500 tokens x 1k runs/day = X tokens/day. If they need Dedicated burst, that's a different SKU — we can simulate throughput on hosted to validate latency first.
Marta (Orion): We'll aim for representative traffic ~1k prompts/day for the POC. Procurement prefers to avoid Dedicated unless necessary.
Evan (AE): OK action list recap: 1) 3pm PT kickoff meeting (today) — Evan to send invite. 2) Marta to share S3 presigned links + questionnaire by EOD Fri. 3) Diego to spin up test endpoints and provide rough cost numbers by EOD. 4) Priya to publish eval harness + success dashboard before meeting. We'll capture owners in the calendar invite.
Priya (Solutions): Anything else? I also want to check integrations: do they need embeddings persisted for long-term ranking experiments? That affects index config and cost.
Marta (Orion): Yes we want embeddings persisted for the POC (30 days). That should be fine.
Evan (AE): Perfect. See you all at 3pm PT. I'll drop the invite now. :thumbsup:
